    beam1 = sandbox.add_static_beam(x=5.71, y=1.92, width=1.0, height=0.16, density=0.5)
    
    # Beam2: Medium zone ceiling (top at build zone upper limit 2.45m) with height 0.16m
    beam2 = sandbox.add_static_beam(x=6.2, y=2.37, width=1.0, height=0.16, density=0.5)
    
    # Beam3: Additional barrier at build zone upper limit to reinforce medium/large separation
    beam3 = sandbox.add_static_beam(x=6.7, y=2.37, width=1.0, height=0.16, density=0.5)
    
    # Ensure non-bouncy material properties to prevent particle bouncing
    for beam in [beam1, beam2, beam3]:
        sandbox.set_material_properties(beam, restitution=0.0)
    
    return beam1  # Return one beam as reference

def agent_action(sandbox, agent_body, step_count):
    pass  # No active control needed; rely on static geometry and gravity
